prompt: Comparative termination review across two executed agreements: first the master services agreement between the analytics vendor and the freight client, then the software license agreement between the grid-software licensor and the UK licensee (execution copy only — ignore the superseded draft). Candidate clause categories (CUAD slugs): termination_for_convenience, post_termination_services, covenant_not_to_sue, liquidated_damages, non_disparagement. For each category, decide per agreement whether it is present, and file one evidence record per present (agreement, category) pair using the tracking mapping: the services agreement is matter legal_matters_001 (legal_matters_evidence_create); the license agreement is conflict record legal_conflicts_001 (legal_conflicts_evidence_create). Rules: query the document store first to identify the correct document(s), read each listed document in full before filing anything, and file exactly one evidence record per clause category that is actually present in the executed text — set evidence_type to the exact category slug, verbatim from the candidate list. Do NOT file a record for any category that is absent from the executed agreement, even if a draft, term sheet, or email mentions it. Use a short quote or section reference of the supporting clause as content_summary, and any reasonable source_uri.
goal: MSA: termination_for_convenience and post_termination_services. License: covenant_not_to_sue only — its convenience-termination clause exists only in the superseded draft. No liquidated damages anywhere.
